output: `JVM` (Java Virtual Machine) compiled `bytecode`-a (`.class` files) run pannura virtual machine, adhunaala Java `platform independent`. `JRE` (Java Runtime Environment) = JVM + core libraries, Java programs-a `run` panna mattum thevai. `JDK` (Java Development Kit) = JRE + `javac` compiler, debugger, tools, Java programs-a `develop` panna thevai. Relationship: `JDK` > `JRE` > `JVM`. Source code `.java` -> `javac` -> bytecode `.class` -> JVM run pannum.

instruction: How does HashMap work internally in Java?
output: `HashMap` internally `array of buckets` vachirukkum. `put(key, value)` pannum bodhu key-oda `hashCode()` calculate panni, array size-oda combine panni `bucket index` kandupidikkum. Rendu keys same bucket-ku vandha (`collision`), andha bucket-la `linked list` (Java 8-la bucket-la 8+ entries-na `Red-Black tree`-a maarum) store aagum. `get()`-la same hash index-ku pogi, `equals()` vachi sariyaana key-a kandupidikkum. Average `O(1)`. Load factor `0.75` thaandina table size double aagi `rehash` aagum. Custom class key-ku `equals()` and `hashCode()` rendaiyum override pannanum.

instruction: What is the difference between String and StringBuilder in Java?
output: Java-la `String` `immutable`, oru vaati create aana maatha mudiyaadhu. `s += "b"` panna ovvoru vaatiyum pudhu `String` object create aagum, loop-la idhu pannaa romba memory and time waste. `StringBuilder` `mutable`, same object-a `append()`, `insert()`, `reverse()` pannalaam, loop-la string build panna romba fast. `StringBuffer` `StringBuilder` maadhiri dhaan aana `thread-safe` (synchronized), konjam slow. Single thread-na `StringBuilder` use pannuvom.

instruction: What is the Open/Closed Principle in SOLID?
output: `Open/Closed Principle`: software entities (classes, modules) `extension`-ku open-a irukkanum, `modification`-ku closed-a irukkanum. Pudhu feature add panna existing tested code-a maatha koodaadhu, pudhu code add pannuvom. Example: `if (type == 'circle') ... else if (type == 'square')` nu `calculateArea` function-la type add panna maaratha badhula, `Shape` interface-a `area()` method-oda create panni, ovvoru shape-um adha implement pannum. Pudhu shape add panna pudhu class dhaan, existing code touch pannaadhu. `Polymorphism` and `interfaces` vachi achieve pannalaam.

instruction: What is the Factory pattern?
output: `Factory pattern` object creation logic-a oru thani `factory` method or class-la centralize pannum, caller `new` use pannaama, `type` kuduthu object-a vaangum. Benefits: caller-ku concrete class theriya thevai illa (`loose coupling`), object create panra logic oru idathula irukkum, pudhu type add panna factory-a mattum maathina pothum. Ungal example-la `ShapeFactory.create('circle')` `Circle` object-a tharum. Database connection types, payment gateways, notification (email/SMS) maadhiri idathula use aagum.

instruction: What is Unicode and how does UTF-8 work?
output: `Unicode` ulagathula ellaa languages-oda characters-kum (Tamil, emoji ellaam) oru unique number (`code point`, example `U+0B85`) assign pannura standard. `UTF-8` andha code points-a bytes-a `encode` pandra variable-length format: ASCII characters `1 byte`, Tamil characters `3 bytes`, emojis `4 bytes`. ASCII-kooda backward compatible, adhunaala web-la dhaan 98% UTF-8 use aagudhu. File save pannum bodhu encoding mismatch aanaa `?` or garbled text varum, example `Ã¢â‚¬`. HTML-la `<meta charset="UTF-8">` use pannuvom.

instruction: How are negative numbers stored using two's complement?
output: Computers-la negative numbers-a `two's complement` use panni store pannuvom. Positive number-oda binary-a eduthu, ellaa bits-aiyum `flip` (0 to 1, 1 to 0) panni, `1` add pannina negative kedaikkum. Example, 8-bit-la `5 = 00000101`, flip `11111010`, `+1` = `11111011` = `-5`. Most significant bit `1` na negative. Benefits: addition and subtraction ore hardware circuit-la panna mudiyum, `0` ku oru representation dhaan. 8-bit signed range `-128` to `127`.

instruction: What is Base64 encoding and why is it used?
input:
btoa('Hello');   // SGVsbG8=
atob('SGVsbG8=');  // Hello
output: `Base64` binary data-va `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `+`, `/` (64 characters) use panni `text`-a maathura encoding. Every 3 bytes-um 4 characters-a maarum, so size `~33%` adhigam aagum. Reason: email, JSON, URLs maadhiri text-only channels-la binary data (images, files) anupa. Example: HTML-la `data:image/png;base64,...` inline images, `JWT` tokens. Idhu `encryption` illa, yaaralayum easy-a decode panna mudiyum, security-ku use panna koodaadhu.

instruction: What is a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack and how do you prevent it?
output: `MITM` attack-la attacker rendu parties-ku (client and server) naduvula secret-a nuzhanju, communication-a `intercept` panni, read pannalaam or modify pannalaam, rendu perum direct-a pesaraanga nu nenaippaanga. Public WiFi-la idhu common. Prevention: `HTTPS/TLS` use pannuradhu (certificate verify pannum), `HSTS` header, certificate pinning, VPN, public WiFi-la sensitive work pannaama irukkuradhu. Browser-la certificate warning vandha ignore pannaadheenga.

instruction: What is Content Security Policy (CSP)?
input: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com
output: `CSP` oru HTTP response header, browser-ku entha sources-la irundhu scripts, styles, images load pannalaam nu `whitelist` solluthu. Ungal example-la `default-src 'self'` na namma own domain-la irundhu mattum, `script-src`-la namma domain and `cdn.example.com`-la irundhu dhaan scripts load aagum. Attacker `XSS` vachi inline `<script>` or vera domain script inject panna try pannaalum browser block pannidum. Inline scripts-a block panna `'unsafe-inline'` use pannaama `nonce` or `hash` use pannanum. `XSS`-kku strong defense layer.

instruction: How does public key cryptography work?
output: `Public key cryptography` (asymmetric) oru `key pair` use pannum: `public key` (ellaarukkum share pannalaam) and `private key` (secret). Public key-la `encrypt` panna data-va private key-la dhaan `decrypt` panna mudiyum. So yaar vendaalum ungalukku public key vachi message anuppalaam, nee mattum dhaan private key vachi padikka mudiyum. Algorithms: `RSA`, `ECC`. Slow-a irukkura nala, TLS-la mudhalla `key exchange`-ku idha use panni, appuram data-ku fast `symmetric` encryption (AES) use pannuvaanga.

instruction: What is a digital signature?
output: `Digital signature` oru message or file yaar anupunaanga nu (`authenticity`) and anuppina appuram maaralanu (`integrity`) prove pannum. Process: sender message-oda `hash` calculate panni, adha `private key`-la `encrypt` pannum (adhu dhaan signature). Receiver sender-oda `public key`-la signature-a decrypt panni hash edukkum, message-oda hash-a thaane calculate panni compare pannum. Match aanaa message genuine. Software updates, HTTPS certificates, JWT (RS256), code signing-la idhu use aagum. Message-a encrypt pannadhu illa, adhu verify panna mattum.

instruction: How does Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) with TOTP work?
output: `2FA` password thavira, rendaavadhu factor-a (something you have) kekkum. `TOTP` (Time-based One-Time Password) apps (Google Authenticator) use pandra method. Setup-la server oru `shared secret key`-a QR code-la tharum, app save pannum. Ovvoru `30 seconds`-kum rendu perum `HMAC(secret, current_time)` vachi `6-digit code` generate pannuvaanga. Login pannum bodhu app code-a nee type pannuvey, server thaane calculate panni compare pannum. Network illaamaye work aagum. SMS OTP-a vida secure, because SIM swap attack illa.

instruction: What is overfitting in machine learning and how do you prevent it?
output: `Overfitting` na model `training data`-va romba nalla-a memorize panni, noise-a kooda kathukittu, `new unseen data`-la poor-a perform pandradhu. Training accuracy high, test accuracy low-a irundha overfitting. Prevent panna: more training data, `cross-validation`, `regularization` (L1/L2), `dropout` (neural networks), simpler model, `early stopping`, feature selection, `data augmentation`. Opposite `underfitting` (model romba simple, training-layaye poor). Goal `generalization`.

instruction: What is the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?
output: `Supervised learning`-la training data-ku `labels` (correct answers) irukkum, model input-la irundhu output predict panna kathukkum. Examples: `classification` (spam or not spam), `regression` (house price predict). `Unsupervised learning`-la labels illa, model data-oda `hidden patterns` thaane kandupidikkum. Examples: `clustering` (customers-a groups-a pirikkardhu, K-Means), `dimensionality reduction` (PCA). Rendukkum naduvula `semi-supervised` and `self-supervised` (LLMs) irukku.

instruction: What is Gradient Descent?
input: w = w - learning_rate * gradient
output: `Gradient Descent` model-oda `loss` (error)-a minimum aakka parameters-a (weights) adjust panna optimization algorithm. Loss function-oda `gradient` (slope) evlo, entha direction-la nu calculate panni, adhukku `opposite` direction-la konjam konjam-a weights-a move pannuvom: `w = w - learning_rate * gradient`. Oru malai-la irundhu kaatu-la kannu kattitu keela irangura maadhiri. `Learning rate` romba periya-na overshoot aagum, romba chinna-na romba slow. Variants: `Batch`, `Stochastic (SGD)`, `Mini-batch`, `Adam`.

instruction: What are tokens in Large Language Models (LLMs)?
output: LLM text-a directly padikkaadhu, mudhalla text-a chinna chinna pieces-a `tokenize` pannum, adhu dhaan `tokens`. Oru token oru full word, word-oda part, or punctuation-a irukkalaam. Example: `'unbelievable'` -> `['un', 'believ', 'able']`. Ovvoru token-kum oru `ID` number, adhu `embedding` vector-a maarum. English-la roughly 1 token = 4 characters. Tamil maadhiri languages-la neraiya tokens aagum, adhunaala cost and context usage adhigam. `Context window` na oru neram-la model process panna mudiyura maximum tokens count, API pricing-um tokens base-la dhaan.

instruction: What is an embedding in machine learning?
output: `Embedding` na words, sentences, images maadhiri data-va oru `vector` (numbers list, example 768 dimensions)-a represent pannuradhu, adhula `meaning` capture aagum. Similar meaning irukkura things-ku vectors-um `close`-a irukkum. Example: `'king'` and `'queen'` vectors near-a irukkum, `'king'` and `'banana'` far-a. `Cosine similarity` vachi closeness measure pannalaam. Use cases: `semantic search`, recommendations, `RAG` (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), clustering. Embeddings-a `vector database` (Pinecone, pgvector)-la store pannuvaanga.

instruction: What is OpenAPI/Swagger and why is it useful?
output: `OpenAPI` (previously Swagger) oru REST API-a describe panna standard specification, usually `YAML` or `JSON` file. Endpoints, request parameters, response schemas, auth ellaam adhula define pannuvom. Benefits: `Swagger UI` vachi interactive documentation auto-generate aagum, adhula direct-a API-a try pannalaam. Client SDKs and server stubs-a code-generate pannalaam. Frontend and backend teams-ku clear `contract`. `FastAPI` automatically OpenAPI docs generate pannum.

instruction: What is gzip compression in HTTP?
input:
Accept-Encoding: gzip, br
Content-Encoding: gzip
output: Client `Accept-Encoding: gzip, br` header-la 'compressed response eduthukkuven' nu solluthu. Server response-a `gzip` or `Brotli` use panni compress panni anuppi, `Content-Encoding` header-la solluthu. Browser decompress pannidum. Text-based files (HTML, CSS, JS, JSON)-ku 70-90% size kammi aagum, so load time fast. Images and videos already compressed, so avanga-ku gzip use illa. Express-la `compression` middleware use pannalaam.

instruction: What is DHCP?
output: `DHCP` (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) network-la connect aagura devices-ku `IP address`, `subnet mask`, `default gateway`, `DNS server` ellaathaiyum automatic-a assign pannum. Manual-a ovvoru device-kum IP set panna thevai illa. Process: `DORA`: `Discover` (client broadcast), `Offer` (server IP offer pannum), `Request` (client accept pannum), `Acknowledge` (server confirm pannum). IP-a oru `lease time`-ku kudukkum, expire aanaa renew pannanum. Home WiFi router-la DHCP server irukkum.

instruction: What is the difference between ping and traceroute?
input:
ping google.com
traceroute google.com
output: `ping` `ICMP Echo Request` packets anuppi, oru host reachable-a nu and `round-trip time` (latency) evlo nu check pannum. Packet loss-um theriyum. `traceroute` (Windows-la `tracert`) packets-oda `TTL` value-a 1, 2, 3 nu increment panni anuppum, ovvoru router TTL zero aana `ICMP Time Exceeded` anuppum, adhunaala destination-ku pogura `path`-la irukkura ovvoru router-um (hop) theriyum. Connection slow-na entha hop-la problem nu kandupidikka traceroute help pannum.

instruction: What is a firewall and how does it work?
output: `Firewall` network traffic-a monitor panni, predefined `rules` vachi `allow` or `block` pannum. Rules usually `source/destination IP`, `port`, `protocol` base-la irukkum. Types: `Packet-filtering` (header check), `Stateful` (connection state track pannum), `Application-layer/WAF` (HTTP content check pannum). Example: port `22` (SSH) specific IP-ku mattum allow pannalaam. Default-a `deny all`, thevai-ya ullathu mattum allow pannuradhu secure approach. AWS `Security Groups`, Linux `iptables`/`ufw` examples.

instruction: What is Blue-Green deployment?
output: Rendu identical production environments maintain pannuvom: `Blue` (ippo live version) and `Green` (pudhu version). Pudhu version-a Green-la deploy panni test pannuvom, user traffic-a Blue-la thaan irukkum. Ellaam okay-na `load balancer` or router-a Green-ku switch pannuvom, instant-a pudhu version live. Edhaachum problem-na udane Blue-ku thirumba switch panna `instant rollback`. Benefits: zero downtime, easy rollback. Drawbacks: rendu environments-ku cost, database schema changes-ku careful-a plan pannanum.

instruction: How do grep and pipes work in Linux?
input: cat app.log | grep "ERROR" | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
output: `grep` text-la pattern-a search pannum (`grep "ERROR" file.log`). `|` (pipe) oru command-oda `output`-a adutha command-oda `input`-a anuppum, so small tools-a combine pannalaam. Ungal command-la: log-la `ERROR` lines-a filter, `sort` panni, `uniq -c` vachi duplicates count panni, count-wise descending-a sort panni, top 10 kaattum. Useful flags: `-i` (case-insensitive), `-r` (recursive), `-v` (invert), `-n` (line numbers). Logs analyze panna romba useful.

instruction: How do cron jobs work in Linux?
input:
# m h dom mon dow command
30 2 * * * /home/user/backup.sh
output: `cron` Linux-la scheduled tasks run panna use aagura daemon. `crontab -e` vachi jobs add pannuvom. Format-la 5 fields: `minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week` and then command. Ungal example `30 2 * * *` na ovvoru naalum 2:30 AM-ku `backup.sh` run aagum. `*/5 * * * *` na ovvoru 5 minutes-kum. Common mistakes: cron-ku `PATH` and environment variables limited, adhunaala absolute paths use pannanum, output-a log file-ku redirect pannanum (`>> log 2>&1`).

instruction: What is the difference between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS?
output: Cloud services-oda three models. `IaaS` (Infrastructure as a Service): virtual machines, storage, network kudukkum, OS-la irundhu namma manage pannanum (AWS EC2). `PaaS` (Platform as a Service): app-a deploy panna platform kudukkum, OS, runtime-a provider paathukkum, namma code mattum (Heroku, Google App Engine). `SaaS` (Software as a Service): ready-made software, namma use panna mattum (Gmail, Google Docs, Slack). IaaS-la adhigam control, SaaS-la kammi control, aana kammi responsibility.

instruction: What is the Strategy pattern?
output: `Strategy pattern`-la oru task-ku different algorithms-a (`strategies`) thani thani classes/functions-a define panni, runtime-la entha strategy use pannanum nu select pannalaam. Ungal example-la `discount` logic cart-ku veliya, pass panra function-a irukku. Pudhu discount type venum-na pudhu strategy add pannina pothum, `if/else` chain venaam. Examples: payment methods (UPI, card), sorting algorithms, shipping cost calculation. `Open/Closed Principle`-a follow pannum.

instruction: What is the MVC pattern?
output: `MVC` (Model-View-Controller) app-a moonu parts-a split pannum. `Model` data and business logic (database interaction). `View` user-ku kaattura UI (HTML templates). `Controller` user input-a handle panni, Model-a call panni, adhula irundhu data-va sariyaana View-ku anuppum. Flow: user request -> Controller -> Model -> Controller -> View -> response. Benefit: `separation of concerns`, ovvoru part-um independent-a develop and test pannalaam. Spring MVC, Django (MVT), Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET MVC use pannum.

instruction: What do DRY, KISS, and YAGNI mean?
output: `DRY` (Don't Repeat Yourself): same logic-a multiple places-la copy paste pannaama, oru function or module-la vechu reuse pannuradhu, so bug fix panna oru idathula pothum. `KISS` (Keep It Simple, Stupid): simple-a irukkura solution-a prefer pannuradhu, over-complicate pannaadheenga. `YAGNI` (You Aren't Gonna Need It): ippo thevai illaadha features-a 'future-la venum' nu munnadiye ezhudhaadheenga. Moonum code-a readable-a, maintainable-a vekka help pannum. Aana DRY-a over-apply panna wrong abstraction varalaam.

instruction: What is technical debt?
output: `Technical debt` na time save panna shortcut or quick-and-dirty solution implement pannuradhu, adhunaala future-la extra work vara vendi irukkum, oru `loan` maadhiri. Example: tests ezhudhaama ship pannuradhu, copy-paste code, hard-coded values, outdated libraries. Ippo fast-a deliver pannalaam, aana time pogapoga 'interest' (bugs, slow development, hard to change) valarum. Konjam debt strategic-a okay, aana regular-a `refactoring` and cleanup-ku time ottukkanum, illana project slow-a aagidum.

instruction: What is the difference between Agile and Waterfall?
output: `Waterfall` sequential model: Requirements -> Design -> Development -> Testing -> Deployment, ovvoru phase-um mudinja appuram dhaan adutha phase. Requirements maaraadhu nu theriyum projects-ku suit aagum, aana late-a feedback kedaikkum, changes costly. `Agile` iterative model: chinna `sprints` (1-4 weeks)-la work-a split panni, ovvoru sprint-layum working software deliver pannuvom, customer feedback vandhu requirements maarinaalum adjust pannalaam. `Scrum`, `Kanban` Agile frameworks. Modern software teams-la Agile dhaan common.

instruction: How do Lomuto and Hoare partition schemes differ in Quick Sort?
output: Rendume `Quick Sort`-oda partition step-a implement panra ways. `Lomuto` scheme-la last element-a `pivot`-a eduthu, oru pointer `i` maintain panni, pivot-ku chinna elements-a left-ku `swap` pannuvom. Simple, purinjikka easy, aana adhigam swaps aagum. `Hoare` scheme-la rendu pointers rendu ends-la irundhu center-ku varum, wrong side-la irukkura rendu elements-a `swap` pannum. Swaps kammi, average-a Lomuto-va vida fast. Rendume `O(n log n)` average, `O(n^2)` worst. Duplicates neraiya irundha Lomuto-la performance kammi aagum.

instruction: How does Bucket Sort work?
output: `Bucket Sort` input-a konjam `buckets`-a split pannum, ovvoru element-um adhoda value range-ku sariyaana bucket-ku pogum. Appuram ovvoru bucket-aiyum thani-a sort pannuvom (usually `Insertion Sort`), kadaisiya ellaa buckets-aiyum order-la join pannuvom. Data `uniformly distributed`-a irundha, floats `0` to `1` range-la irukkum bodhu, average `O(n + k)` aagum. Ellaa elements-um ore bucket-ku poita worst case `O(n^2)`. Comparison-based sort illa, so `O(n log n)` limit-a break pannum.

instruction: What is Exponential Search and when do you use it?
output: `Exponential Search` oru sorted array-la, size theriyaadha or romba periya array-la target-a find panna use aagum. Mudhalla index `1, 2, 4, 8, 16...` nu double pannitte pogi, `arr[i] >= target` aagura range-a kandupidippom. Appuram andha range-kulla `Binary Search` pannuvom. Time `O(log n)`. Target array-oda start-ku kitta irundha `Binary Search`-a vida fast. Infinite or unbounded sorted data-la search panna idhu nalla option.

instruction: How do you find the diameter of a binary tree?
output: `Diameter` na tree-la rendu nodes-ku naduvula irukkura longest path-oda edges count. Ovvoru node-layum, adhoda `left height + right height` dhaan andha node vazhiya pogura longest path. So `height()` function-a recursion-la use panni, ovvoru node-layum `l + r`-a `best`-oda compare panni update pannuvom, height `1 + max(l, r)` return pannuvom. Idhunaala oru single traversal-la `O(n)` time-la mudiyum. Diameter root vazhiya pogalanum nu avasiyam illa, adhu common mistake.

instruction: How do you invert a binary tree?
output: `Invert` na ovvoru node-oda `left` and `right` children-a `swap` pannuradhu, so tree mirror image aagum. Recursion-la ovvoru node-kum mudhalla rendu subtrees-aiyum invert panni, appuram avangala swap pannuvom. `Base case` `!root` na `null` return. Time `O(n)`, space `O(h)` recursion stack-ku (`h` tree height). BFS with `queue` use panni iterative-aum panna mudiyum. Idhu romba famous interview question.

instruction: How do you find the Kth smallest element in a BST?
output: BST-oda `inorder traversal` eppavum values-a sorted order-la tharum, so `k`-th element-a visit pannum bodhu stop pannidalaam. Ungal code iterative inorder: left-ku poitte `stack`-la push pannuvom, appuram pop panni visit pannuvom, `k` zero aana adhu dhaan answer, illana `right` subtree-ku pogum. Full traversal panna thevai illa, so time `O(h + k)`. Tree-ku frequent insert/delete irundha, ovvoru node-layum `subtree size` store pannaa `O(h)`-la answer kedaikkum.

instruction: What is the inorder successor in a BST?
output: BST-la oru node-oda `inorder successor` na sorted order-la adhukku `aduthu` varra node, adhavadhu adhai vida periya values-la chinnadhu. Rendu cases: (1) Node-ku `right subtree` irundha, adhula `leftmost` node dhaan successor. (2) Right subtree illa-na, root-la irundhu search pannitte vandhu, node-a `left` side-la thaandi vandha last ancestor dhaan successor. Time `O(h)`. Idhu BST delete operation-layum, iterator implement panna-layum use aagum.

instruction: How does Morris Traversal work?
output: `Morris Traversal` tree-a inorder-la `O(1)` extra space-la traverse pannum, `recursion` or `stack` illaama. Idea: current node-oda `left subtree`-la `rightmost` node-oda `right` pointer-a temporary-a current node-ku point panna vechuruvom (`threaded link`). Appuram left-ku pogalaam, thirumba thread-a follow panni vandhu current-a visit pannalaam, appuram thread-a remove pannidalaam. Time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`. Drawback: tree-a temporary-a modify pannum, so multi-threaded-la safe illa.

instruction: How do you count the number of islands in a grid?
output: Grid-la `'1'` land, `'0'` water. Ovvoru cell-aiyum scan pannuvom, `'1'` kidacha oru pudhu island kidaichiduchu nu `count++` pannitu, `DFS` (or `BFS`) vachi andha island-oda connected ellaa land cells-aiyum `'0'`-a maathi (visited mark) vidduvom, so thirumba count aagaadhu. 4 directions-ku DFS call pannuvom. Time `O(rows * cols)`. Idhu `connected components` problem-oda grid version. Original grid-a modify panna koodaadhu-na separate `visited` array use pannalaam.

instruction: How do you check if a graph is bipartite?
output: `Bipartite graph` na nodes-a rendu groups-a split panna, ovvoru edge-um rendu different groups-a connect pannanum, same group-kulla edge irukkaadhu. Check panna `BFS` or `DFS` vachi nodes-a `2 colors`-la color pannuvom. Oru node-a color `0`-nu vechi, adhoda neighbors-a color `1` aakkuvom. Edhaachum neighbor already same color-la irundha, `bipartite illa`. Graph-la `odd length cycle` irundha adhu bipartite illa. Time `O(V + E)`. Disconnected graph-na ovvoru component-kum check pannanum.

instruction: What are articulation points and bridges in a graph?
output: `Articulation point` (cut vertex) na oru node-a remove panna graph disconnect aagidum. `Bridge` na oru edge-a remove panna graph disconnect aagidum. Network-la single point of failure kandupidikka idhu useful. `Tarjan's algorithm` `DFS` vachi ovvoru node-kum `discovery time` and `low-link value` (adhu reach panna mudiyura earliest ancestor) calculate pannum. Edge `(u, v)`-la `low[v] > disc[u]` na adhu `bridge`. Time `O(V + E)`.

instruction: How do you solve Unique Paths in a grid using DP?
output: `m x n` grid-la top-left-la irundhu bottom-right-ku, right or down move mattum panna, evlo different paths irukku nu kekkuradhu. Oru cell-ku vara `top` cell-la irundhu or `left` cell-la irundhu varalaam, so `paths[r][c] = paths[r-1][c] + paths[r][c-1]`. First row and column-la ellaathukkum `1` way dhaan. Ungal code-la `2D table` badhula `1D array` use panni space `O(n)`-ku kuraichirukku. Time `O(m * n)`. Combinatorics formula `C(m+n-2, m-1)`-layum solve pannalaam.

instruction: How do you solve Partition Equal Subset Sum?
output: Array-a rendu subsets-a split panni rendoda sum-um same-a irukkuma nu kekkuradhu. Total sum `odd`-na impossible. Even-na `target = sum / 2` kandupidikka oru subset irukkaanu paakkanum, idhu `0/1 Knapsack` maadhiri problem. `dp[s]` na sum `s` form panna mudiyuma. Ovvoru number-kum `s`-a `target`-la irundhu `n` varaikkum `reverse`-la loop pannuvom, apo dhaan same number-a rendu vaati use pannaama irukkum. Time `O(n * target)`, space `O(target)`.

instruction: How do you solve the Word Break problem?
output: String `s`-a dictionary words-a split panna mudiyuma nu check pannuradhu. `dp[i]` na `s`-oda first `i` characters-a break panna mudiyum nu artham. `dp[0] = true` (empty string). Ovvoru `i`-kum, `j < i` ellaa split points-aiyum try pannuvom: `dp[j]` true-um, `s[j..i]` dictionary-la irundhum na `dp[i] = true`. Dictionary-a `Set`-a maathuna lookup `O(1)`. Time `O(n^2)` (substring cost thavira). Last-la `dp[n]` dhaan answer.

instruction: How do you find the Longest Palindromic Substring using expand around center?
output: Ovvoru palindrome-kum oru `center` irukkum. Odd length-ku center oru character (`expand(i, i)`), even length-ku center rendu characters-ku naduvula (`expand(i, i + 1)`). Ovvoru center-la irundhu rendu pakkamum `s[l] === s[r]` irukkura varaikkum expand pannuvom. Ovvoru center-kum longest palindrome-a track panni, kadaisiya best-a return pannuvom. Time `O(n^2)`, space `O(1)`. `Manacher's algorithm` idha `O(n)`-ku kondu varum.

instruction: How do you solve the Maximum Product Subarray problem?
output: Sum-a vida product-la `negative` numbers tricky: rendu negatives multiply aanaa positive aagum. Adhunaala ovvoru index-layum `max` product-a mattum illa, `min` product-aiyum track pannuvom. Current number negative-na, `min * n` periya value-a aagalaam. Ovvoru step-layum `n` alone, `max * n`, `min * n` moonu-la max and min-a eduthukkuvom. Zero vandha adhu automatic-a reset aagum. Time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`.

instruction: How does the Activity Selection problem use a greedy approach?
output: Neraiya activities-ku `start` and `finish` time irukku, oru person-a `overlap` aagaama maximum evlo activities attend panna mudiyum nu kekkuradhu. Greedy strategy: activities-a `finish time` base-la sort pannuvom, mudhal activity-a select pannuvom, appuram munnadi select pannadhoda finish time-ku appuram start aagura next activity-a select pannuvom. Early-a mudiyura activity-a pick pannaa melum activities-ku time meedhi irukkum, adhunaala idhu optimal. Time `O(n log n)`, sorting dhaan dominant.

instruction: How does Huffman Coding work?
output: `Huffman Coding` oru data compression technique, adhula frequent-a varra characters-ku `short codes`, rare characters-ku `long codes` assign pannuvom. Steps: ovvoru character-oda frequency count pannuvom, ellaathaiyum `min heap`-la podurom. Rendu chinna frequency nodes-a eduthu merge panni, sum frequency-oda pudhu node-a thirumba heap-la podurom, oru tree aagura varaikkum repeat. Root-la irundhu `left = 0`, `right = 1` nu codes assign pannuvom. Idhu `prefix-free` code, so decode panna ambiguity illa. Greedy-ku nalla example.

instruction: How do you solve Jump Game using a greedy approach?
output: `nums[i]` na `i` index-la irundhu maximum jump length. Last index-ku reach aaga mudiyuma nu check pannanum. Greedy-a, ovvoru index-layum `farthest` (ippo varaikkum reach panna mudiyura max index)-a track pannuvom. Current index `i` `farthest`-a vida periya-na, andha position-ku reach aaga mudiyaadhu, `false`. Illana `farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i])`. Time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`. DP-la `O(n^2)`-la panna mudiyum, aana greedy better.

instruction: How do you merge K sorted linked lists?
output: Brute force-a ellaa nodes-aiyum oru array-la podhu sort pannalaam, `O(N log N)`. Better approach: `min heap` (priority queue)-la ovvoru list-oda `head` node-a pottuvom. Heap-la irundhu smallest-a pop panni result list-la serthuvom, adhoda `next` node-a heap-la podhuvom. Heap size eppavume `k` dhaan, so ovvoru operation-um `O(log k)`. Total time `O(N log k)` (`N` na total nodes). Alternative: `divide and conquer`-la rendu rendu lists-a merge pannitte pogalaam.

instruction: How do you find the K Closest Points to the origin?
output: Distance compare panna `sqrt` thevai illa, `x*x + y*y` pothum (squared distance). Simple approach: ovvoru point-kum distance calculate panni sort panni mudhal `k` edukkuradhu, `O(n log n)`. Better: size `k` `max heap` vachi, heap-oda top (current-la irukkura `k` points-la farthest) ippo vara point-a vida periya-na replace pannuvom. Time `O(n log k)`. `Quickselect` use panna average `O(n)`. `k` chinna-va irundha heap approach nalla.

instruction: How do you design a Min Stack that returns the minimum in O(1)?
output: Normal stack-la minimum kandupidikka `O(n)` aagum. Idha `O(1)`-ku kondu vara, rendu stacks maintain pannuvom: main `stack` and `mins` stack. Ovvoru `push`-layum, ippo varaikkum minimum-a `mins` stack-la push pannuvom. `pop` pannum bodhu rendu stacks-layum pop pannuvom. So `getMin()` `mins`-oda top-a return pannidum. Ovvoru operation-um `O(1)`, space `O(n)`. Idhu stack-oda state-a ovvoru level-layum remember panna oru nalla technique.

instruction: How do you evaluate a postfix (Reverse Polish) expression using a stack?
output: `Postfix` notation-la operator operands-oda `pinnadi` varum (`3 4 +`), brackets thevai illa. Left-la irundhu right-ku tokens-a padichu: number-na `stack`-la push, operator-na stack-la irundhu rendu numbers-a `pop` panni calculate panni result-a thirumba push. Order mukkiyam: `b` mudhalla pop aagum, `a` rendaavadhu, so `a - b`, `a / b`. Last-la stack-la irukkura oru value dhaan answer. Time `O(n)`. Compilers expression evaluation-ku idha use pannum.

instruction: How do you find the Largest Rectangle in a Histogram?
output: `Monotonic stack` use pannuvom, adhula bar indexes increasing height order-la irukkum. Pudhu bar `cur` stack top-a vida chinna-na, top bar-oda rectangle `extend` aagaadhu, so adha pop panni area calculate pannuvom. Width = `i - left - 1`, `left` na stack-la meedhi irukkura previous index (smaller bar). Ovvoru bar oru vaati push, oru vaati pop, so `O(n)`. Kadaisiya `0` height-a sentinel-a vechu meedhi irukkura bars-aiyum pop pannuvom.

instruction: How do you group anagrams together?
output: Anagrams-oda characters same, order dhaan different, so `sorted characters` same-a irukkum. Ovvoru word-oda sorted version-a `key`-a use panni, `Map`-la same key-oda words-a group pannuvom. `'eat'`, `'tea'`, `'ate'` ellaam `'aet'` key-ku pogum. Time `O(n * k log k)` (`k` word length). Sorting badhula 26-length `character count` array-a key-a use panna `O(n * k)`-ku improve pannalaam.

instruction: How do you find the Longest Consecutive Sequence in an unsorted array?
output: Sort pannaa `O(n log n)`, aana `O(n)`-la panna `Set` use pannuvom. Ovvoru number `n`-kum, `n - 1` set-la illa-na, adhu oru sequence-oda `start`. Start-la irundhu `n+1`, `n+2`... irukkura varaikkum count pannuvom. Start illaadha numbers-a skip pannidrathunaala, ovvoru number-um max rendu vaati dhaan visit aagum, so time `O(n)`. Space `O(n)`.

instruction: How do you find the number of subarrays with sum equal to K?
output: `Prefix sum` and `hash map` combination. `prefix[j] - prefix[i] = k` na `i+1` to `j` subarray-oda sum `k`. So ovvoru position-la current `sum`-a calculate panni, `sum - k` idhukku munnadi evlo vaati vandhuruku nu `Map`-la paathu `count`-la serthuduvom. Appuram current `sum`-oda frequency-a update pannuvom. `{0: 1}`-oda start pannuvom, array start-la irundhu varra subarray-ku. Negative numbers irundhaalum work aagum (sliding window aagaadhu). Time `O(n)`.

instruction: How do you compute Product of Array Except Self without using division?
output: `res[i]` = `i`-ku left-la irukkura ellaa numbers-oda product x right-la irukkura ellaa numbers-oda product. Mudhal pass-la left-la irundhu right-ku `left` running product-a `res[i]`-la store pannuvom. Rendaavadhu pass-la right-la irundhu left-ku `right` running product-a `res[i]`-oda multiply pannuvom. Division use pannala, so zero values-a handle panna problem illa. Time `O(n)`, extra space `O(1)` (output array thavira).

instruction: How does the 3Sum problem work?
output: Sum `0` varra unique triplets kandupidikkanum. Mudhalla array-a `sort` pannuvom. Ovvoru `i`-kum, mathha rendu numbers-a `Two Pointers` (`l` and `r`) vachi find pannuvom. Sum `< 0` na `l++`, `> 0` na `r--`, `0` na triplet-a save pannuvom. Duplicates skip pannanum (`i`-kum, `l`-kum, `r`-kum), illana same triplet repeat aagum. Time `O(n^2)`, brute force `O(n^3)`-a vida romba better.

instruction: How do you solve Trapping Rain Water?
output: Oru bar-la thanni nikkum alavu `min(left max, right max) - height`. Two pointers-a rendu ends-la irundhu use pannuvom. `h[l] < h[r]` na left side-oda limit `lMax` dhaan (right-la already periya bar irukku), so `lMax - h[l]` water add pannitu `l++`. Illana right side-ku same logic. Prefix arrays use pannaa space `O(n)`, intha approach-la `O(1)`. Time `O(n)`. `Monotonic stack`-layum solve pannalaam.

instruction: How do you solve Container With Most Water?
output: Rendu vertical lines select panni, kooda `x-axis` vachi oru container-a form pannuvom, area = `min(height) * width`. `Two pointers` rendu ends-la start pannuvom (max width). Ovvoru step-layum chinna height irukkura pointer-a thaan move pannuvom, because periya height pointer-a move pannaa width kammi aagum, height-um improve aagaadhu (min height limit-a irukkum). Chinna pointer-a move pannaa dhaan area increase aaga chance irukku. Time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`.

instruction: How do you find the duplicate number in an array using Floyd's algorithm?
output: `n + 1` numbers `1` to `n` range-la irukku, oru duplicate irukku. Array-a oru `linked list`-a treat pannuvom, `index -> nums[index]` nu next pointer. Duplicate irukkura nala oru `cycle` irukkum, cycle-oda entry point dhaan duplicate number. `Floyd's cycle detection` (tortoise and hare)-la mudhalla slow-um fast-um meet aagura varaikkum pogum, appuram `slow`-a start-ku konduvandhu rendu perum oru step-a move pannuvom, meet aagura idam cycle entry. Time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`, array-a modify pannaama.

instruction: What is the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm for finding the majority element?
output: Majority element na array-la `n/2`-kku mela vara element. `Boyer-Moore` `O(1)` space-la one pass-la kandupidikkum. `candidate` and `count` maintain pannuvom. Same element vandha `count++`, different vandha `count--`. `count` zero aana pudhu `candidate` select pannuvom. Majority element ovvoru different element-oda 'cancel' aanaalum kooda meedhi irukkum, adhunaala kadaisiya adhu dhaan candidate. Majority irukkum nu guarantee illa-na, last-la verify pannanum.

instruction: How do you move all zeroes to the end of an array in-place?
output: Two pointers: `r` (read) ovvoru element-aiyum paakkum, `w` (write) next non-zero value-a vekka vendiya position. `nums[r]` zero illa-na, `nums[w]`-oda `swap` panni `w++` pannuvom. Idhunaala non-zero elements-oda relative order maaraama, zeroes-ellaam end-ku pogidum. Single pass, time `O(n)`, space `O(1)`. Idhe pattern dhaan `Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array`, `Remove Element` problems-kum use aagum.

instruction: How do you search in a Rotated Sorted Array?
output: Sorted array-a `[4,5,6,7,0,1,2]` maadhiri rotate pannirukkum. Ovvoru `mid`-layum rendu halves-la at least oru half `sorted`-a irukkum. `nums[lo] <= nums[mid]` na left half sorted. Target andha sorted half-oda range-kulla irundha adhula search pannuvom, illana mathha half-ku pogalaam. Right half sorted-na same logic. Idhunaala ovvoru step-layum search space half aagum, time `O(log n)`. Duplicates irundha worst case `O(n)` aagum.

instruction: How do you print a matrix in spiral order?
output: Naalu boundaries (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`) maintain pannuvom. Mudhalla top row left-la irundhu right-ku, appuram right column top-la irundhu bottom-ku, appuram bottom row right-la irundhu left-ku, kadaisiya left column bottom-la irundhu top-ku. Ovvoru direction mudinja udane andha boundary-a kulla move pannuvom (`top++`, `right--`...). Rendavadhu mudhal rendu direction-ku appuram boundaries cross aagirukkuma nu check pannanum, illana single row/column matrices-la duplicate aagum. Time `O(m * n)`.

instruction: How do you rotate an image (matrix) by 90 degrees in-place?
output: `N x N` matrix-a clockwise `90°` rotate panna, extra matrix illaama `2 steps` pannuvom. (1) `Transpose`: `m[i][j]`-a `m[j][i]`-oda swap pannuvom (diagonal-ku mela irukkura half mattum, `j = i + 1`-la irundhu). (2) Ovvoru `row`-aiyum `reverse` pannuvom. Anti-clockwise venum-na transpose-ku appuram rows badhula `columns` reverse pannanum (or mudhalla rows reverse pannitu transpose). Time `O(n^2)`, space `O(1)`.

instruction: How do you find the intersection node of two linked lists?
output: Rendu linked lists oru node-la merge aagi, appuram same-a continue aagum. Two pointers `p` and `q` vachi: `p` list `a`-la, `q` list `b`-la start aagum. Oru pointer end-a reach panna, adha vera list-oda head-ku maathidvom. Rendu pointers-um `lenA + lenB` steps-a total-a travel pannum bodhu, same distance-la intersection-la meet aagum. Intersection illa-na rendume `null`-la meet aagi `null` return aagum. Time `O(m + n)`, space `O(1)`.

instruction: How do you implement a Queue using two Stacks?
output: Stack `LIFO`, queue `FIFO`, so rendu stacks-a use pannuvom. `inS`-la ellaa pudhu elements-um `push` aagum. `pop` or `peek` pannum bodhu `outS` empty-na, `inS`-la irundhu ellaa elements-aiyum `outS`-ku move pannuvom, appo order reverse aagi `front` element top-ku varum. `outS` empty illa-na adhula irundhu direct-a pop. Ovvoru element-um max oru vaati dhaan move aagum, so `amortized O(1)` per operation.

instruction: What is Reservoir Sampling?
output: Data stream-oda size theriyaadhu, memory-ku ellaathaiyum store panna mudiyaadhu, appo `k` random items-a equal probability-oda select pannanum. `Reservoir Sampling`-la mudhal `k` items-a reservoir-la vechuruvom. `i`-th item (`i > k`) vandha, `0` to `i-1` range-la random index `j` generate pannuvom, `j < k` na `reservoir[j]`-a pudhu item-a replace pannuvom. Idhunaala stream-oda ovvoru item-kum select aagura probability `k/n` equal-a irukkum. Space `O(k)`, one pass.

instruction: How does the Fisher-Yates shuffle work?
output: Array-a unbiased-a shuffle panna `Fisher-Yates` best. Kadaisi index-la irundhu `0` varaikkum, ovvoru `i`-kum `0` to `i` range-la random `j` select panni `arr[i]`-oda swap pannuvom. Ovvoru permutation-kum equal probability `1/n!`. Time `O(n)`, in-place. `arr.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5)` use pannuradhu biased result tharum, adhu common mistake.

instruction: How do you implement a Trie-based autocomplete?
output: `Trie`-la ovvoru character oru node, root-la irundhu path follow panna prefix kedaikkum. Autocomplete-ku user type panna `prefix`-a Trie-la follow pannuvom, andha prefix node-la irundhu `DFS` panni, `isEndOfWord` marked ellaa words-aiyum collect pannuvom. Prefix search `O(L)` (`L` prefix length), independent of total words count. Ovvoru node-layum `frequency` or `score` store panni top suggestions-a rank pannalaam. Search boxes, IDE code completion, spell checkers-la idhu use aagum.

instruction: What is the difference between Big O, Big Omega, and Big Theta?
output: `Big O` `upper bound` (worst case limit): algorithm evlo slow-a pogum nu max. `Big Omega` `lower bound`: minimum evlo time edukkum. `Big Theta` `tight bound`: upper and lower bound rendume same-a irundha, exact growth rate. Example: `Linear Search` `O(n)` worst case, `Omega(1)` best case (first element-lae kedaikkum). `Merge Sort` `Theta(n log n)` eppavum. Interview-la neraiya per `Big O`-a worst case nu use pannuvaanga, technically adhu bound dhaan, case illa.

instruction: What is the Master Theorem for solving recurrence relations?
output: Divide and conquer algorithms-oda time complexity `T(n) = a * T(n/b) + f(n)` maadhiri recurrence-a varum. `a` subproblems count, `b` size reduction factor, `f(n)` divide and combine cost. `Master Theorem` `n^(log_b a)`-a `f(n)`-oda compare pannum: `f(n)` chinna-na `T(n) = Theta(n^(log_b a))`, rendum same-na `Theta(n^(log_b a) * log n)`, `f(n)` periya-na `Theta(f(n))`. Example: `Merge Sort` `T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n` -> `Theta(n log n)`. `Binary Search` `T(n) = T(n/2) + 1` -> `Theta(log n)`.

instruction: What is tail recursion and why does it matter?
output: `Tail recursion`-la recursive call function-oda `last operation`-a irukkum, adhukku appuram edhuvum compute pannaadhu. Normal `n * factorial(n - 1)`-la call mudinja appuram multiply pannanum, so ovvoru call-kum stack frame vechirukkanum. Tail-recursive version-la `acc` accumulator-la result-a carry pannrathunaala, compiler `Tail Call Optimization (TCO)` panni same frame-a reuse pannidum, `stack overflow` varaadhu. Aana JavaScript engines-la TCO mostly support illa, Scheme, Haskell, Scala-la irukku.

instruction: What is the Temporal Dead Zone in JavaScript?
input:
console.log(a);
let a = 5;
output: `let` and `const` variables-um hoist aagum, aana initialize aagura line varaikkum access panna mudiyaadhu. Block start-la irundhu declaration line varaikkum irukkura andha gap dhaan `Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ)`. Andha zone-la variable access panna `ReferenceError` varum. Ungal code-la `console.log(a)` TDZ-la irukku, so error. `var`-la hoist aagi `undefined` kedaikkum, adhunaala error varaadhu. TDZ bugs-a early-a catch panna help pannum.

instruction: What does the new keyword do in JavaScript?
output: `new` use pannum bodhu 4 steps nadakkum. (1) Oru pudhu empty object create aagum. (2) Andha object-oda `__proto__` constructor-oda `prototype`-a point pannum. (3) Constructor function run aagum, `this` andha pudhu object-a irukkum. (4) Constructor vera object return pannala-na, pudhu object automatic-a return aagum. `new` illaama `Person('Raj')` call panna `this` global (or `undefined` in strict mode) aagum, adhu common bug.

instruction: How do getters and setters work in JavaScript classes?
output: `get` property-a read pannum bodhu run aagum, `set` property-a assign pannum bodhu run aagum. Method maadhiri `()` illaama `user.name`-nu access pannalaam. Setter-la validation add pannalaam, getter-la computed value return pannalaam. Ungal code-la `_name` internal field, `name` public interface. `_` convention sollum 'idhu private maadhiri'. Real private fields-ku `#name` syntax use pannalaam. Encapsulation panna idhu help pannum.

instruction: What is the difference between Promise.race and Promise.any?
output: `Promise.race` mudhalla `settle` aagura (resolve or reject) promise-oda result-a return pannum. Ungal example-la `fail` udane reject aagura nala `race` reject aagum. `Promise.any` mudhalla `fulfill` aagura promise-oda value-a return pannum, rejects-a ignore pannum. Example-la `any` `'slow'` return pannum. Ellaa promises-um reject aana `AggregateError` throw pannum. Timeout implement panna `race`, fastest successful server select panna `any` use pannuvom.

instruction: How does AbortController cancel a fetch request?
output: `AbortController` oru request-a cancel panna use aagum. `controller.signal`-a `fetch` options-la pass pannuvom. `controller.abort()` call panna fetch cancel aagi, promise `AbortError` oda reject aagum. React-la `useEffect` cleanup-la abort panna, component unmount aana appuram ila stale search request-a cancel pannalaam, race conditions avoid aagum. `setTimeout` vachi timeout implement-aum pannalaam. Network bandwidth-um save aagum.

instruction: What is IntersectionObserver and what is it used for?
output: `IntersectionObserver` oru element viewport-kulla (or oru parent-kulla) visible aagudha nu `asynchronously` watch pannum. Scroll event listener-a vida efficient, main thread-a block pannaadhu. Use cases: `lazy loading` images, `infinite scroll`, scroll-trigger animations, ad view tracking. Ungal code-la `.card` screen-la vandha `visible` class add aagum. `threshold` option vachi evlo % visible aana trigger aaganum nu set pannalaam.

instruction: What is the difference between reflow and repaint in the browser?
output: `Reflow` (layout) na browser elements-oda `size and position`-a thirumba calculate pandradhu. `width`, `height`, `margin`, `font-size` maathuna idhu nadakkum, romba costly, because mathha elements-um affect aagalaam. `Repaint` na position maaraama `visual appearance` (color, background, visibility) maathuna pixels-a thirumba draw pandradhu, kammi cost. Reflow-na repaint-um varum, aana repaint-na reflow varanum nu illa. `transform` and `opacity` animations-ku GPU use aagum, reflow illa, adhunaala animations-ku adhai prefer pannuvom.

instruction: What is the Critical Rendering Path?
output: Browser HTML-a screen-la pixels-a maatha pandra steps-oda sequence. (1) `HTML` parse panni `DOM` tree build. (2) `CSS` parse panni `CSSOM` build. (3) DOM + CSSOM serthu `Render Tree` (visible elements mattum). (4) `Layout` (reflow) size/position calculate. (5) `Paint` pixels draw. (6) `Composite` layers-a serthu. CSS `render-blocking`, `<script>` (no `async/defer`) `parser-blocking`. Optimize panna critical CSS inline pannuradhu, scripts-a `defer` pannuradhu, resources kammi panradhu.

instruction: What are srcset and the picture element for responsive images?
output: Mobile-ku periya image anuppinaa bandwidth waste. `srcset` oru image-oda multiple versions-a (different widths) browser-ku kudukkum, `sizes` attribute image evlo space-la display aagum nu solluthu, browser screen size and pixel density base-la sariyaana file-a select pannum. `<picture>` with `<source>` use panna different `formats` (`webp`, `avif`) or art direction (mobile-ku crop pannina image) kudukkalaam. `alt` attribute accessibility-ku always venum. Idhu LCP and page speed improve pannum.

instruction: What is the Shadow DOM and Web Components?
output: `Web Components` framework illaama reusable custom HTML elements create panna native browser standard. `Custom Elements` (`customElements.define`) pudhu tag define pannum. `Shadow DOM` oru component-oda internal DOM and CSS-a veliya irundhu `isolate` pannum, ungal `<style>` outside page-a affect pannaadhu, outside CSS-um component-kulla vaaradhu. `<template>` and `<slot>` content-a flexible aakkum. Design systems-la framework-a depend pannaama share panna idhu use aagum.

instruction: How do you implement dark mode using prefers-color-scheme?
output: `prefers-color-scheme` media query user-oda OS/browser theme `dark` ah `light` ah nu detect pannum. Colors-a `CSS variables`-la define pannitu, dark media query-kulla variables-oda values-a override pannuvom, so `body` CSS maaratha vendaam. User manual-a toggle panna vendi irundha, `<html data-theme="dark">` attribute vachi adhukku CSS-um ezhudhi, choice-a `localStorage`-la save pannalaam. `color-scheme: dark light` property form controls, scrollbars-um theme-a adjust pannum.

instruction: What is the CSS clamp() function?
output: `clamp(min, preferred, max)` oru value-a minimum and maximum-kku naduvula limit pannum. Ungal example-la font size `4vw` (screen width-oda 4%) base-la maarum, aana `1.5rem`-ku keela pogaadhu, `3rem`-ku mela pogaadhu. Idhunaala media queries illaama `fluid typography` and spacing kedaikkum. Width, padding, margin-ku kooda use pannalaam. `min()` and `max()` functions-um irukku, adhu simpler cases-ku.

instruction: What are CSS container queries?
output: Media queries `viewport` size-a paarkum, aana `container queries` oru component-oda `parent container` size-a paarkum. Oru card component sidebar-la (narrow) irundhaalum, main area-la (wide) irundhaalum, adhoda container size-ku ethaa maadhiri layout maathikkum. Parent-la `container-type: inline-size` set pannanum, appuram `@container (min-width: ...)` use pannalaam. Reusable components design panna idhu romba useful, media queries-a vida component-friendly.

instruction: What is the difference between CSS Modules and CSS-in-JS?
output: `CSS Modules` normal `.css` files, build time-la class names-a unique-a maathidum (`.button` -> `.button_x7a2`), so scope local aagum, conflicts varaadhu. Runtime cost illa. `CSS-in-JS` (`styled-components`, `Emotion`) JavaScript-kulla CSS ezhudhuvom, props base-la dynamic styles easy, aana runtime-la styles generate aagura nala konjam overhead irukkum (zero-runtime options `vanilla-extract`, `Linaria` irukku). Static styles-ku CSS Modules, highly dynamic theming-ku CSS-in-JS. Tailwind-um oru third option.

instruction: What is the difference between Webpack and Vite?
output: `Webpack` oru `bundler`, development-layum ellaa modules-aiyum bundle pannitu dhaan server start aagum, project periya-na slow. `Vite` development-la browser-oda native `ES Modules` use pannum, source files-a bundle pannaama on-demand-a serve pannum, adhunaala server start and `HMR` (Hot Module Replacement) instant-a irukkum. Dependencies-a `esbuild` vachi pre-bundle pannum. Production build-ku `Rollup` use pannum. Pudhu projects-ku Vite popular, Webpack-oda configuration-a adhigam customize panna vendi vandha Webpack.

instruction: What is tree shaking?
output: `Tree shaking` bundle-la irundhu `unused code`-a (dead code) remove pandra optimization. Ungal example-la `unused` function import aagala, so final bundle-la serkkaadhu. Idhu `ES Modules` (`import/export`) static structure-a irukkura nala dhaan work aagum, `CommonJS require` dynamic-a irukkura nala tree shake panna mudiyaadhu. `package.json`-la `sideEffects: false` set panna bundler-ku safe-a remove panna help pannum. Bundle size kammi aagum, page load fast.

instruction: What is the difference between a transpiler and a polyfill?
output: `Transpiler` (`Babel`, `TypeScript`) pudhu syntax-a pazhaya browsers purinjikkura syntax-ku `convert` pannum, example arrow functions, `class` -> `function`, `async/await` -> generators. Syntax level change. `Polyfill` browser-la illaadha pudhu `API/method`-a JavaScript-la implement panni add pannum, example `Array.prototype.includes`, `Promise`, `fetch` (`core-js`). Syntax-a convert panna mudiyum, ana new feature-a polyfill dhaan kudukkum. `browserslist` config vachi entha browsers support pannanum nu decide pannuvom.

instruction: What are union types and type narrowing in TypeScript?
output: `Union type` (`string | number`) oru variable rendu or adhigam types-la oru-nna irukkalaam nu solluthu. Union-la common methods-a mattum dhaan direct-a use panna mudiyum. `Type narrowing`: `typeof`, `instanceof`, `in`, equality checks, or custom `type guards` vachi, TypeScript compiler `if` block-kulla type-a specific-a purinjikkum. Ungal code-la `if` block-la `id` `string`, `else`-la `number`. `Discriminated unions` (`kind` field vachi) narrowing-ku romba powerful.

instruction: What are TypeScript utility types like Partial, Pick, Omit, and Record?
output: `Partial<T>` ellaa properties-aiyum `optional` aakkum (update payloads-ku). `Pick<T, K>` specific properties-a mattum edukkum. `Omit<T, K>` specific properties-a remove pannum. `Record<K, V>` keys `K`, values `V` irukkura object type create pannum. `Required<T>` ellaathaiyum mandatory aakkum, `Readonly<T>` immutable aakkum. Idhunaala same type-a thirumba ezhudha thevai illa, `DRY` maintain aagum. Ellaam `mapped types`-oda built-in versions.

instruction: Why should you enable strict mode in tsconfig.json?
output: `"strict": true` oru shortcut, adhu pala strict checks-a ON pannum: `noImplicitAny` (type theriyaadha variable-ku `any` auto assign aagaadhu), `strictNullChecks` (`null`/`undefined`-a explicit-a handle pannanum), `strictFunctionTypes`, `strictPropertyInitialization` ellaam. Idhunaala runtime-la varra `Cannot read property of undefined` maadhiri bugs-a compile time-laye pidikkalaam. Existing JS project-a migrate pannum bodhu konjam kashtam, aana pudhu projects-ku always `strict` ON-la vekkanum.

instruction: What are enums in TypeScript and what are their drawbacks?
output: `enum` named constants group create pannum. Numeric enums-la default-a `0, 1, 2` values varum, reverse mapping-um irukku. Drawbacks: enum runtime-la extra JavaScript code generate pannum (type-only illa), numeric enums-la edhaachum number assign panna mudiyum (type-safety kammi). Alternative-a `as const` object + union type use pannuvaanga, adhu plain JavaScript-a compile aagum, bundle-ku light. String enums (`'admin'`) numeric-a vida safe-a irukkum.

instruction: What is the Node.js EventEmitter?
output: `EventEmitter` Node.js-oda core class, `observer pattern`-a implement pannum. `on(event, listener)` oru event-ku listener-a register pannum, `emit(event, ...args)` andha event-a trigger panni ellaa listeners-aiyum run pannum. `once()` oru vaati mattum run aagum, `off()` listener-a remove pannum. Node-oda `streams`, `http` server, `fs` ellaam EventEmitter-a extend pannirukku. Listeners synchronous-a, register pannina order-la run aagum. `error` event-ku listener illa-na process crash aagum.

instruction: What are worker_threads in Node.js?
output: Node.js main thread single-threaded, CPU-heavy task (image processing, big loops) irundha event loop block aagidum. `worker_threads` separate thread-la andha heavy work-a run panna help pannum. Workers `postMessage` / `on('message')` vachi communicate pannum, `SharedArrayBuffer` vachi memory-um share pannalaam. `cluster` module separate processes create pannum, `worker_threads` same process-kulla threads. I/O-heavy work-ku Node-oda async model-ae pothum, CPU-bound-ku dhaan worker threads.

instruction: What is a Buffer in Node.js?
output: `Buffer` Node.js-la `raw binary data`-va handle panna use aagura class, oru fixed-size memory chunk. Files, network sockets, images maadhiri binary data-va read/write panna thevai. `Buffer.from('text', 'utf8')` string-a bytes-a maathum, `buf.toString('base64')` thirumba string or other encoding-ku maathum. `Uint8Array`-oda subclass. `Streams` data-va chunks-a (Buffers) anupum. `Buffer.alloc(n)` zero-filled memory tharum, `allocUnsafe` fast aana old data irukkalaam.

instruction: What is semantic versioning (SemVer)?
output: `SemVer` version number `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` format-la irukkum. `PATCH` bug fixes (backward compatible), `MINOR` pudhu features (backward compatible), `MAJOR` `breaking changes`. Example `4.18.2` -> `4.19.0` safe, `5.0.0` code maathanum. `package.json`-la `^4.18.2` na `4.x.x` latest-ku update allow (major maaraadhu), `~4.18.2` na `4.18.x` mattum (patch), exact `4.18.2` na fixed. `package-lock.json` exact versions lock pannum.

instruction: Why do we use ESLint and Prettier?
output: `ESLint` code-a `analyze` panni bugs and bad patterns-a kandupidikkum (unused variables, `==` use, missing `await`), customizable rules, sila issues auto-fix-um pannum. `Prettier` oru `code formatter`, indentation, quotes, semicolons, line length maadhiri style-a automatic-a format pannum, style debates-a mudichidum. ESLint code quality, Prettier code formatting. Rendaiyum serthu use pannuvom (`eslint-config-prettier` conflicts avoid pannum). `pre-commit hooks` (Husky) and CI-la run panna team-la consistent code kedaikkum.

instruction: How do you write a basic unit test using Jest?
output: `Jest` popular JavaScript testing framework. `test()` (or `it()`) oru test case define pannum, `describe()` related tests-a group pannum. `expect(value)` oda `matchers` (`toBe`, `toEqual`, `toContain`, `toThrow`) vachi assertions ezhudhuvom. `toBe` primitive/reference equality, `toEqual` objects-oda deep equality. `beforeEach`/`afterEach` setup-cleanup-ku. `jest.fn()` and `jest.mock()` mocking-ku. `npx jest --coverage` test coverage report tharum.

instruction: What is the useTransition hook in React?
output: `useTransition` oru state update-a `non-urgent` (low priority)-a mark panna udhavum. Ungal code-la `setInput` urgent, user type pannum bodhu input udane update aaganum. `setFilter` `startTransition`-kulla irukkura nala, periya list re-render slow-a irundhaalum UI freeze aagaadhu, urgent updates mudhalla nadakkum. `isPending` transition nadakkum bodhu loading indicator kaatta use aagum. React 18-oda `concurrent rendering` feature. Heavy filtering, tab switching-ku useful.

instruction: What is the useId hook in React?
output: `useId` oru component-ku `unique, stable ID` generate pannum, accessibility attributes-ku (`htmlFor`, `aria-describedby`) use panna. `Math.random()` or counter use panna `SSR` and client-la different IDs varum, `hydration mismatch` aagum. `useId` server and client rendering-la same ID tharum, adhunaala safe. List items-ku `key`-a use panna koodaadhu, adhu key-ku illa. Same component-a multiple times render panna kooda ovvoru instance-kum different ID kedaikkum.

instruction: What is the difference between client state and server state in React apps?
output: `Client state` UI-oda local data, browser-la mattum irukku, namma full control: modal open/close, form inputs, selected tab, theme. `useState`, `useReducer`, `Zustand`, `Context` use pannuvom. `Server state` backend-la irukkura data, `async`-a fetch pannanum, vera users maathalaam, `stale` aagalaam, caching, refetching, loading/error states handle pannanum. `React Query`, `SWR` idhukku best. Rendaiyum separate-a manage pannuradhu Redux-la ellaathaiyum podura-a vida simple-a irukkum.

instruction: How do forms work with React Hook Form?
output: `React Hook Form` `uncontrolled inputs` and `refs` vachi work pannum, so ovvoru keystroke-kum re-render aagaadhu, performance nalla irukkum. `register('field', rules)` input-a form-oda connect pannum, validation rules (`required`, `minLength`, `pattern`) kudukkalaam. `handleSubmit` validate pannitu dhaan `onSubmit` call pannum. `errors` object-la validation messages kedaikkum. `Zod`, `Yup` schema validation-oda integrate pannalaam. Controlled forms-a vida boilerplate romba kammi.

instruction: How do layouts work in the Next.js App Router?
input:
app/
  layout.tsx
  page.tsx
  dashboard/
    layout.tsx
    page.tsx
output: Next.js App Router-la `app` folder-kulla folder structure URL routes-a decide pannum. `page.tsx` oru route-a publicly accessible aakkum. `layout.tsx` andha folder and adhoda ellaa child routes-kum shared UI (navbar, sidebar), layouts `nest` aagum, navigate pannum bodhu layout `re-render aagaadhu`, state maintain aagum. Root `app/layout.tsx` `<html>` and `<body>` define pannanum. `loading.tsx` and `error.tsx` automatic Suspense and Error Boundary create pannum. Default-a ellaa components-um `Server Components`.

instruction: What is middleware in Next.js?
output: Next.js `middleware` request complete aagi page or API-ku pogum `munnadi` edge-la run aagura code. `NextResponse` vachi `redirect`, `rewrite`, headers/cookies set pannalaam. Ungal example-la token illaadha user `/dashboard`-ku vandha `/login`-ku redirect aagum. `matcher` config entha paths-ku run aaganum nu limit pannum. Auth checks, `i18n` redirects, A/B testing, logging-ku use aagum. Edge runtime-la run aagura nala Node.js APIs sila available illa.

instruction: What is the difference between localStorage and IndexedDB?
output: `localStorage` simple key-value store, values `strings` mattum, `synchronous` (main thread-a block pannum), size limit `~5MB`. Chinna settings, theme preference-ku nalla. `IndexedDB` browser-oda full `NoSQL database`, structured objects, `Blob`/files store pannalaam, `asynchronous`, `indexes`, `transactions` support, size periya (hundreds MB). Offline apps, caching big data, PWA-ku use pannuvom. API complex-a irukkura nala `idb` or `Dexie.js` wrapper libraries use pannuvom. Rendume same-origin, XSS-na thirudalaam.

instruction: What is a Progressive Web App (PWA)?
input:
{
  "name": "My App",
  "short_name": "App",
  "start_url": "/",
  "display": "standalone",
  "icons": [{ "src": "icon.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png" }]
}
output: `PWA` oru website-a native app maadhiri feel kudukkura approach. 3 main requirements: `HTTPS`, `Web App Manifest` (name, icons, `display: standalone` - home screen-la install pannalaam), and `Service Worker` (offline support, caching, push notifications). Benefits: install pannalaam, offline work aagum, app store thevai illa, single codebase. Limitations: iOS-la sila features restricted, native hardware access kammi. `Lighthouse` PWA checklist check pannum.

instruction: What is the difference between ARIA attributes and semantic HTML for accessibility?
input: Save
output: Accessibility-ku mudhal priority `semantic HTML` dhaan. `<button>` use panna keyboard focus, `Enter`/`Space` key support, screen reader announcement ellaam free-a kedaikkum. `ARIA` (`role`, `aria-label`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-live`) semantic HTML-la cover aagaadha custom widgets-ku (tabs, modals, custom dropdowns) extra information kudukkum. Ungal `div role="button"`-la keyboard handling and focus-a manual-a ezhudhanum, adhunaala 'First rule of ARIA: native HTML element irundha adha use pannu'. ARIA behavior-a add pannaadhu, semantics mattum dhaan.

instruction: What is the difference between the DOM and the BOM?
output: `DOM` (Document Object Model) HTML document-a tree structure-a represent pannum, `document.getElementById()`, `querySelector()` vachi elements-a access/modify pannalaam. `BOM` (Browser Object Model) browser-oda other parts-a access panna: `window`, `navigator` (browser info), `location` (URL), `history`, `screen`, `localStorage`, `setTimeout`. BOM-ku official standard illa (browsers-ku browser vary aagalaam), DOM W3C standard. `window` BOM-oda root object, `window.document` DOM-a point pannum.

instruction: What is minification and why is it done?
output: `Minification` JavaScript, CSS, HTML files-la irundhu `unnecessary characters`-a (whitespace, comments, newlines) remove panni, variable names-a chinna-a maathi (`userCount` -> `a`) file size-a kuraikkum. Behavior maaraadhu. Chinna file-na download fast, page load speed improve aagum. Production build-la tools (`Terser`, `esbuild`, `cssnano`) automatic-a pannum. `Source maps` vachi minified code-oda errors-a original code-la debug pannalaam. Minification-oda `gzip/Brotli` compression-um serthu use pannuvom.

instruction: How does iframe sandboxing improve security?
input: <iframe src="https://third-party.com/widget" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe>
output: `<iframe>` vera site-oda content-a embed pannum, adhu risky aagalaam. `sandbox` attribute iframe-oda capabilities-a default-a ellaathaiyum block pannum: scripts run aagaadhu, forms submit aagaadhu, popups open aagaadhu, parent navigate panna mudiyaadhu, `same-origin` access illa. Thevaiyaanadhu mattum `allow-scripts`, `allow-forms`, `allow-same-origin` maadhiri values-oda allow pannuvom. `allow-scripts` and `allow-same-origin` rendaiyum serthu kudutha sandbox-a escape pannalaam, so avoid pannanum. Clickjacking-ku `X-Frame-Options` or `frame-ancestors` CSP use pannuvom.

instruction: What is the CORS preflight request?
input:
OPTIONS /api/users HTTP/1.1
Origin: https://app.example.com
Access-Control-Request-Method: PUT
Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type
output: Browser 'non-simple' cross-origin requests-ku (example `PUT`, `DELETE`, custom headers, `Content-Type: application/json`) real request anuppadhukku munnadi, `OPTIONS` method-oda oru `preflight` request anuppum. Server 'indha origin, method, headers allow' nu `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, `Access-Control-Allow-Methods`, `Access-Control-Allow-Headers` response headers-la sollanum. Allow aana dhaan browser actual request anuppum. `Access-Control-Max-Age` preflight result-a cache pannum. Server-la `OPTIONS` handle pannala-na CORS error varum.

instruction: What is HTTP keep-alive and connection reuse?
input: Connection: keep-alive
output: HTTP-la ovvoru request-kum puthusa `TCP connection` (and `TLS` handshake) open pannaa romba latency. `Keep-alive` oru TCP connection-a multiple requests-ku `reuse` panna allow pannum, so handshake cost kammi. HTTP/1.1-la default-a ON. Server `Keep-Alive: timeout=5` solli idle connection-a evlo neram open vechukkum nu decide pannum. `HTTP/2` oru single connection-la multiple requests parallel-a anupum (`multiplexing`). Node.js `http.Agent({ keepAlive: true })` outgoing requests-ku use pannalaam.

instruction: What is the difference between HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 (QUIC)?
output: `HTTP/2` `TCP` mela run aagum, `multiplexing` irukku, aana TCP-oda `head-of-line blocking` problem: oru packet lose aanaa ellaa streams-um wait pannum. `HTTP/3` `QUIC` protocol-a (`UDP` mela) use pannum, ovvoru stream-um independent, oru stream packet loss maththa streams-a affect pannaadhu. `TLS 1.3` built-in, `0-RTT` connection setup, `connection migration` (WiFi-la irundhu mobile data-ku maaridha connection break aagaadhu). Mobile and unstable networks-la HTTP/3 better.

instruction: What is the difference between Socket.IO and native WebSocket?
output: `WebSocket` browser-oda native API, oru bidirectional connection mattum tharum, low-level. `Socket.IO` oru library, WebSocket mela build aagirukku, extra features: automatic `reconnection`, `fallback` (long polling) WebSocket fail aanaa, `rooms` and `namespaces`, `broadcasting`, acknowledgements, heartbeat. Chat apps, notifications-ku Socket.IO easy. Aana Socket.IO server and client rendum Socket.IO-va dhaan irukkanum, plain WebSocket client-oda connect aagaadhu. Simple use-ku native WebSocket pothum.

instruction: What is the difference between Django, Flask, and FastAPI?
output: `Django` oru `batteries-included` framework: ORM, admin panel, authentication, forms, migrations ellaam built-in, big projects-ku nalla. `Flask` oru `micro-framework`, minimal core mattum, thevaiyaanadhai extensions-a add pannuvom, romba flexible. `FastAPI` modern, `async` support, `Pydantic` type hints vachi automatic validation and `OpenAPI` docs generate pannum, APIs-ku romba fast and developer-friendly. Full website with admin-na Django, simple small app-na Flask, high performance REST API-na FastAPI.

instruction: How do models and the ORM work in Django?
input:
class Book(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    price = models.DecimalField(max_digits=6, decimal_places=2)

Book.objects.filter(price__lt=500).order_by('title')
output: Django-la oru `model` class oru database table-a represent pannum, ovvoru field oru column. `makemigrations` and `migrate` commands table create or update pannum. `Book.objects` `Manager` vachi database queries-a Python code-la ezhudhalaam, SQL ezhudha thevai illa. `filter(price__lt=500)` na `WHERE price < 500`. Queries `lazy`, nee data use pannum bodhu dhaan database-ku pogum. `select_related` and `prefetch_related` vachi N+1 problem avoid pannalaam.

instruction: What do @RestController, @Autowired, and @GetMapping do in Spring Boot?
output: `@RestController` indha class HTTP requests-a handle pannum, methods return pandra objects automatic-a `JSON`-a maaridum. `@RequestMapping("/users")` base URL set pannum. `@GetMapping("/{id}")` `GET /users/5` request-a andha method-ku map pannum, `@PathVariable` URL-la irundhu `id`-a edukkum. `@Autowired` Spring `UserService` bean-a automatic-a inject pannum (`Dependency Injection`). Constructor injection `@Autowired` field injection-a vida better, test panna easy.

instruction: What are bean scopes in Spring?
output: Spring `bean` na Spring container manage panra object. `Singleton` (default): container-kulla oru instance dhaan, ellaa idathulayum same object share aagum. `Prototype`: ovvoru time request pannum bodhum pudhu instance create aagum. Web apps-ku `Request` (ovvoru HTTP request-kum oru instance), `Session` (ovvoru user session-kum), `Application` scopes irukku. Singleton beans-la mutable state vachaa multiple threads-la problem varum, so singleton beans `stateless`-a irukkanum.

instruction: What is the difference between lazy and eager loading in Hibernate?
output: `EAGER` loading-la parent entity-a load pannum bodhu related entities-aiyum udane load pannidum, thevai illanaalum data varum, performance cost. `LAZY` loading-la related data-va `access pannum bodhu` dhaan load aagum (`author.getBooks()` call pannum bodhu). `@OneToMany` default LAZY, `@ManyToOne` default EAGER. Lazy loading-la `session close` aana appuram access panna `LazyInitializationException` varum. Lazy use pannaa N+1 problem varalaam, adhukku `JOIN FETCH` or `@EntityGraph` use pannalaam.

instruction: What is the difference between ArrayList and LinkedList in Java?
output: `ArrayList` internally dynamic `array`, index vachi `get(i)` `O(1)`, end-la `add` amortized `O(1)`, aana naduvula insert/delete `O(n)` (elements shift aagum). `LinkedList` doubly linked list, `get(i)` `O(n)`, aana first/last-la add/remove `O(1)`, naduvula iterator irundha insert/delete `O(1)`. Memory-um LinkedList-la adhigam (ovvoru node-kum pointers). Practice-la `ArrayList` cache-friendly, mostly adhu fast-a irukkum, adhunaala default choice ArrayList. Queue/Deque use-ku `ArrayDeque` better.

instruction: What is the equals() and hashCode() contract in Java?
output: Contract: rendu objects `equals()`-la equal-na, avanga `hashCode()`-um same-a irukkanum. Aana same `hashCode` irukkura objects equal-a irukkanum nu avasiyam illa (collision). `equals()` override pannitu `hashCode()` override pannaama vittaa, `HashMap`/`HashSet`-la equal objects different buckets-ku pogum, `map.get()` null return pannum, duplicates serum. `Objects.hash()` use pannalaam, Java 16+ `record` automatic-a rendaiyum generate pannum. Immutable fields-a vachi hash calculate pannuradhu safe.

instruction: What is the difference between checked and unchecked exceptions in Java?
output: `Checked exceptions` (`IOException`, `SQLException`) compile time-la check aagum, `try/catch` panna or `throws` declare pannanum, illana compile error. External problems-ku (file illa, network down) use aagum. `Unchecked exceptions` (`RuntimeException` subclasses: `NullPointerException`, `IllegalArgumentException`, `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`) compiler force pannaadhu, usually programming bugs. `Error` (`OutOfMemoryError`) JVM-oda serious problems, catch panna koodaadhu. Modern code-la neraiya per unchecked exceptions-a prefer pannuvaanga (Spring maadhiri).

instruction: What do synchronized and volatile do in Java?
output: `synchronized` oru time-la oru thread dhaan andha method/block-kulla pogalaam nu `lock` pannum, `mutual exclusion` and `visibility` rendum tharum. `count++` atomic illa (read, add, write), adhunaala synchronized venum. `volatile` variable-oda value-a thread-ku thread `visible`-a vekkum (CPU cache-la stale value irukkaadhu), aana `atomicity` tharaadhu, so flags (`running`) ku nalla, counters-ku illa. Counters-ku `AtomicInteger` use pannalaam, adhu lock-free.

instruction: What is a thread pool and how does ExecutorService work in Java?
output: Ovvoru task-kum pudhu thread create panna costly. `Thread pool` oru fixed number of threads-a munnadiye create panni, tasks-a queue-la podhum, free-a irukkura thread edukkum, mudinja appuram thread reuse aagum. `ExecutorService.submit()` task-a anuppi `Future` return pannum, `get()` result varura varaikkum wait pannum. `shutdown()` call pannanum, illana JVM exit aagaadhu. `CompletableFuture` async chaining-ku. Pool size CPU-bound tasks-ku cores count-a, I/O-bound-ku adhigam.

instruction: What are Java Streams?
input:
List<String> result = names.stream()
    .filter(n -> n.startsWith("A"))
    .map(String::toUpperCase)
    .sorted()
    .collect(Collectors.toList());
output: `Stream` collections-a functional style-la process panna API (Java 8+). Pipeline: `source` -> `intermediate operations` (`filter`, `map`, `sorted`, lazy-a run aagum) -> `terminal operation` (`collect`, `forEach`, `reduce`, `count`, terminal call pannum bodhu dhaan ellaam run aagum). Original collection-a maathaadhu. Streams oru vaati dhaan consume pannalaam. `parallelStream()` multi-core use pannum, aana small data-ku overhead dhaan. Loops-a vida declarative-a, readable-a irukkum.

instruction: What is Optional in Java and how should you use it?
input:
Optional<User> user = repo.findById(id);
String name = user.map(User::getName).orElse("Guest");
output: `Optional<T>` oru value irukkalaam or illaama irukkalaam nu `explicit-a` represent pannum, `NullPointerException` avoid panna. `Optional.of(x)`, `Optional.empty()`, `Optional.ofNullable(x)`. `map()`, `orElse()`, `orElseThrow()`, `ifPresent()` use pannalaam. Best practices: method `return type`-a use pannuvom, `fields` or method `parameters`-a use panna koodaadhu, `get()`-a `isPresent()` check illaama call panna koodaadhu. Collections-ku `Optional<List>` badhula empty list return pannuvom.

instruction: What are wildcards in Java generics?
input:
void printAll(List<? extends Number> list) { }
void addInts(List<? super Integer> list) { list.add(1); }
output: `List<Integer>` `List<Number>`-oda subtype illa (generics invariant). `? extends Number` (`upper bounded wildcard`) `Number` or adhoda subclasses-oda list-a accept pannum, aana namma adhula irundhu read mattum pannalaam, add panna mudiyaadhu (`Producer Extends`). `? super Integer` (`lower bounded`) `Integer` or adhoda superclasses-oda list-a accept pannum, namma adhula `add` pannalaam (`Consumer Super`). `PECS` rule nyabagam vechukkonga. `?` plain wildcard type-a pathi kavalaipadaadha idathula.

instruction: What is the difference between final, finally, and finalize in Java?
output: `final` oru keyword: variable-ku value maatha mudiyaadhu (constant), method-ku override panna mudiyaadhu, class-ku extend panna mudiyaadhu. `finally` `try/catch`-oda block, exception vandhaalum illanaalum eppavum run aagum, cleanup-ku. `finalize()` `Object` class-oda method, garbage collector object-a remove pannum munnadi call pannum nu solluvaanga, aana timing guarantee illa, Java 9-la `deprecated`, use panna koodaadhu. Resource cleanup-ku `try-with-resources` and `AutoCloseable` use pannuvom.

instruction: What are dataclasses in Python?
input:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Point:
    x: int
    y: int = 0

p = Point(3)
print(p)
output: `@dataclass` decorator data store panra classes-ku `__init__`, `__repr__`, `__eq__` methods-a automatic-a generate pannum, boilerplate kammi. Type hints-oda fields define pannuvom, default values kudukkalaam. `Point(3)` print panna `Point(x=3, y=0)` nu varum. `frozen=True` immutable aakkum (hashable-um aagum), `order=True` comparison methods add pannum. Mutable defaults-ku (`list`) `field(default_factory=list)` use pannanum, illana error varum.

instruction: What does if __name__ == '__main__' do in Python?
output: Ovvoru Python file-kum `__name__` nu oru built-in variable irukku. File-a direct-a run panna (`python app.py`) `__name__` `'__main__'` aagum. Vera file-la `import app` panna `__name__` `'app'` (module name) aagum. Adhunaala `if __name__ == '__main__':` kulla irukkura code direct run pannum bodhu mattum execute aagum, import pannum bodhu run aagaadhu. Idhunaala oru file-a script-a and reusable module-a rendume use pannalaam.

instruction: What are type hints in Python?
input:
def greet(name: str, times: int = 1) -> str:
    return (name + ' ') * times

from typing import Optional
def find(id: int) -> Optional[str]: ...
output: `Type hints` function parameters, return values, variables-oda expected types-a annotate pannum. Python runtime-la idha enforce pannaadhu, adhu documentation and tooling-ku. `mypy`, `pyright` maadhiri static type checkers code run pannaama type errors-a kandupidikkum. IDE autocomplete nalla work aagum. `Optional[str]` na `str` or `None`, `list[int]`, `dict[str, int]`. `FastAPI` and `Pydantic` type hints-a vachi validation panna use pannum.

instruction: What is a pandas DataFrame?
input:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({'name': ['Raj', 'Anu'], 'age': [25, 30]})
df[df['age'] > 26]
df.groupby('city')['sales'].sum()
output: `DataFrame` pandas-oda main data structure, rows and columns-oda `2D table` (Excel sheet or SQL table maadhiri). Ovvoru column oru `Series`, adhukku data type irukkum. `df[df['age'] > 26]` boolean filtering. `groupby()` group panni aggregate pannum. `read_csv()`, `to_csv()`, `merge()` (SQL join maadhiri), `fillna()` missing values handle pannum, `apply()`. Data cleaning and analysis-ku Python-la standard tool. Romba periya data-ku memory issue varum, appo `chunksize` or `Polars` use pannalaam.

instruction: What is vectorization in NumPy and why is it fast?
input:
import numpy as np
a = np.arange(1_000_000)
result = a * 2 + 1   # vectorized

result2 = [x * 2 + 1 for x in range(1_000_000)]  # python loop
output: `Vectorization` na Python loop use pannaama, array-oda ellaa elements-kum oru operation-a `oru-vaati-la` apply panradhu (`a * 2 + 1`). NumPy arrays `contiguous memory`-la same data type-la store aagum, operations `C` code-la (and SIMD instructions) run aagum, so Python-oda per-element overhead (type checking, object creation) illa. Idhunaala 10-100x fast. `broadcasting` vachi different shapes-oda arrays-a combine pannalaam. Machine learning and data science-ku idhu foundation.

instruction: What are pointers in C and how do they work?
output: `Pointer` oru `memory address`-a store panra variable. `&x` `x`-oda address-a tharum, `int *p` oru int-oda address-a hold pannum. `*p` (`dereference`) andha address-la irukkura value-a read/write pannum. Ungal code-la `*p = 20` `x`-oda value-a `20`-a maathidum. Arrays, strings, dynamic memory (`malloc`), function-ku reference pass panradhu ellaam pointers-a vachi dhaan. Pointer arithmetic (`p + 1`) adhoda type size-ku move aagum. Wrong pointer use panna crashes and security bugs varum.

instruction: How do malloc and free work in C?
output: `malloc(size)` `heap`-la `size` bytes memory allocate panni, adhoda pointer-a (`void *`) return pannum, memory kedaikala-na `NULL` return pannum, adhunaala check pannanum. `free(ptr)` andha memory-a thirumba OS/allocator-ku kudukkum. `free` pannala-na `memory leak`. Rendu vaati `free` panna `double free` bug. `free` pannadhukku appuram adha use panna `use-after-free`. Safe practice: `free` pannitu pointer-a `NULL` aakkuradhu. `calloc` zero-initialized memory tharum, `realloc` size maathum. Tools: `Valgrind`, `AddressSanitizer`.

instruction: What is a segmentation fault?
input:
int *p = NULL;
*p = 5;
output: `Segmentation fault` (`segfault`) na program ethukku access pannakoodaadha memory-a access panna try pannum bodhu OS program-a kill pandra error. Common causes: `NULL` pointer dereference (ungal code), `dangling pointer` use, array `out-of-bounds` access, `stack overflow` (deep recursion), read-only memory-la write panna try pannuradhu. Debug panna `gdb` or `Valgrind`/`AddressSanitizer` use pannalaam. `-g` flag-oda compile panna line number theriyum. Java/Python-la idhu varaadhu, avanga exceptions throw pannuvaanga.

instruction: What is a dangling pointer?
output: `Dangling pointer` na oru pointer already `free` aana (or scope-ku veliya poita) memory-a innum point pandradhu.
